C - CITIGROUP’S $35 BILLION ACCOUNTING ERROR SPARKS SHAKE-UP Citigroup understated risk-weighted assets by $35 billion at its London operations, according to The Wall Street Journal. The bank reportedly injected $3 billion into a major UK subsidiary to address the error. At least two managing directors overseeing regulatory reporting are no longer in their positions. The incident raises fresh concerns about Citigroup’s internal controls and regulatory oversight.
